title: Jesus, Saviour, Pilot Me
description: Jesus, Saviour, Pilot Me in Tonic Solfa to PILOT: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Edward Hopper, a Presbyterian minister who pastored the Church of Sea and Land, a church for sailors in New York, wrote the words; they were published in 1871. John Edgar Gould composed the tune PILOT for them the same year.
underlay: Je-sus, Sav-iour, pi_-lot me, O-ver life’s tem-pes-tuous sea; Un-known waves be-fore me roll, Hid-ing rock and treach-’rous shoal; Chart and com-pass come_ from Thee: Je-sus, Sav-iour, pi-lot me!

lines: Chart and compass come from Thee:
As a mother stills her child,
Thou canst hush the ocean wild;
When Thou say’st to them, “Be still!”
When at last I near the shore,
Then, while leaning on Thy breast,
May I hear Thee say to me,
